name: Aprilia
verdict: A brand of Piaggio & C. S.p.A. (Piaggio Group), Milan-listed and controlled by the listed holding Immsi S.p.A. Nothing found.
note: MotoGP partner of SuperFile Trackhouse MotoGP Team (the team races Aprilia RS-GP26 bikes), per trackhouse.com/partners (checked 2026-10-03 via Wayback Machine). Owner chain: Aprilia is a Piaggio Group brand (aprilia-piaggio-ownership); Piaggio is listed on the Milan Stock Exchange and controlled by Immsi S.p.A., itself a listed industrial holding (piaggio-immsi-control). No state or fund stake found; no human-rights finding against Piaggio or Immsi found (checked 2026-10-03).
